items.title: Get form messages by email
items.detail: 1 form(s) came across. Messages are kept in OpenSpace; choose where to get an email when someone writes.

items.title: Bring your newsletter subscribers
items.detail: Sign-up forms came across, but subscribers stay with Wix. Export them there and import them here.

items.title: Use courtneyacamo.com for your new site
items.detail: Your new site is live on a free address. When you're happy with it, we'll help you point courtneyacamo.com at it — your old site keeps working until then.

items.title: Check special features
items.detail: Your old site had add-ons (chat, booking or other widgets). See which ones you still need.

items.title: Use your own font licence
items.detail: Your old site used forum and avenir-lt-w01_35-light1475496, which we're not allowed to copy, so the closest free fonts stand in (Forum, Jost). If you have a web licence, download the font files (WOFF2) from the font service and upload them in Site Styles → Your fonts — they're stored in media/fonts/ — then choose them for your headings and text.
